newsitem.title: NEW ZEALAND: Fletcher Challenge details bonus scheme.
newsitem.headline: Fletcher Challenge details bonus scheme.

text.p: Fletcher Challenge Ltd on Tuesday provided details of a bonus issue associated with the reorganisation of its employee unit trust announced on May 15.
Fletcher Challenge Building, Energy and Paper shareholders will be entitled to four fully paid Forests shares for every 100 Building, Energy and Paper shares held at 5 pm on June 27.
The new Forests shares will rank equally with all existing Forests shares.
The Building, Energy and Paper shares will commence trading "ex" entitlement on June 30 on the NZSE and on the Australian exchange on June 19.
All holders at 5 pm on June 27 of ADRs representing Fletcher Challenge Building, Energy and Paper shares will be entitled to four fully paid Forests ADRs for every 100 Building, Energy or paper ADRs.
The Fletcher Challenge Building, Energy and Paper ADRs will commence trading "ex" on the NYSE on June 24.
Fletcher said it believes the distribution was not taxable.
